abilities.effect: The room rotates 45 degrees, closing of the room by shifting its exits to face bare walls. A pendulum of force swings across the platform with the armor on it, knocking the armor into the pit and making a pendulum blade Strike against a creature on that platform (if any). The trap then rolls for initiative.
abilities.name: Locking Room
abilities.trigger: A creature disturbs any of the platforms, or anything falls into the pit

abilities.name: Pendulum Shove
abilities.text: A creature hit by a pendulum blade must succeed at a DC 44 Refex save or be moved 5 feet along the line of the pendulum's swing. This is forced movement.

damage.effect: pendulum shove; no multiple attack penalty

traits.name: Fatal
traits.text: The fatal trait includes a die size. On a critical hit, the weapon’s damage die increases to that die size instead of the normal die size, and the weapon adds one additional damage die of the listed size.

traits.name: Force
traits.text: Effects with this trait deal force damage or create objects made of pure magical force.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text:
Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. A magical item radiates a magic aura infused with its dominant school of magic.  
  
 Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

hazard.description: Several swinging pendulums of force cleave through the room across the platforms, knocking people into the pit.
hazard.disable: DC 48 Arcana (legendary), DC 44 Thievery (master), or *dispel magic* (9th level; counteract DC 44) on a platform to deactivate its pendulum blade; once all five platforms have been deactivated, the trap is disabled and the room rotates back into position along the exits. DC 48 Thievery (legendary) from any blocked exit to activate the rotating mechanism and rotate the room back into position before the trap has been disabled.
hazard.name: Pendulum Pit
hazard.reset: The trap resets after 1 hour. If the darkness throughout the room has been dispelled, the darkness in the room returns when the trap resets.
hazard.routine: (5 actions) For each active platform, the trap uses an action to create a pendulum of force to swing down along a straight line between the platform and one other creature in the room that isn't on the platform (if any). The trap makes a pendulum blade attack against any creature in that line. For each platform deactivated, reduce the number of actions the trap takes in its routine by 1.

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.note: to realize the chamber is a complex rotating trap before it triggers. No check is necessary to notice the platforms and the pit.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text:
Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. A magical item radiates a magic aura infused with its dominant school of magic.  
  
 Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard or item with this trait is constructed to hinder interlopers.
